ready.retained.measurement_notes: Components use 4-connectivity and nonzero alpha; fragmentation is a measurement, not automatic aesthetic failure.

successor-adoption-02.paused.candidate.measurement_notes: Components use 4-connectivity and nonzero alpha; fragmentation is a measurement, not automatic aesthetic failure.

criteria.name: geometry
criteria.check: Decode the delivered PNG as exactly one static 16x16 frame; no strip, animation or extra canvas.

criteria.name: transparent-exterior.diagnostic
criteria.check: Retain per-cell alpha histogram and nonzero-alpha component boxes. Flag a component touching all four edges or covering more than half the cell for visual review only. No flag value is an acceptance/rejection threshold; a full-span glyph or deliberate backing can be valid. Alpha-zero RGB is insignificant.

criteria.name: transparent-exterior
criteria.check: Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336, every frame's intended exterior shows the panel with no unintended opaque canvas matte, tile, halo or fringe. A deliberate backing shape is permitted if part of the recorded subject design with transparent exterior. Partial alpha and selective intentional anti-aliasing are permitted; binary alpha is not required. RGB values where alpha is zero are insignificant. This visual record decides transparency appearance; measured alpha/component flags do not reject artwork.

criteria.name: pause-meaning-without-color
criteria.check: Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 in colour and in a non-colour comparison (grayscale or binarized silhouettes), the mark reads as paused work and is identifiable by shape alone against Ready (completion), every Working frame (activity), Retry and the preserved Start triangle. No specific pause motif (such as paired bars) is required.

criteria.name: style-coherence
criteria.check: Readable compact silhouette, deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges consistent with the exact Ready baseline (selective, intentional anti-aliasing is permitted under the full-alpha contract; accidental resampling blur or stray noise is not), and a perceptible cool-blue accent related to the Ready baseline and the preserved Start accent, judged qualitatively at 1x and 3x on #172336; no exact hex, palette count, binary alpha, stroke width or margin rule.

criteria.name: consumers
criteria.check: In the supplied browser fixture (renderer-successor/view.mjs executing the actual src/queue.ts and src/queue-view-successor.ts), exercise pause -> paused through stateAfter: both statusCell and compactStatus resolve {label Paused, path renderer-successor/assets/paused.png, frames 1}; the live cells (scale 3) and the state-matrix cells (scale 1 and 3) render the PNG with imageSmoothingEnabled false / image-rendering pixelated over #172336, geometryMatches true, and no animation loop runs for the descriptor (frames 1).
